segments.en: Through the merit of serving the Tzadik — a person is saved from death.
Closeness to the Tzadik is good — in this world and in the World to Come.

When the Tzadik says some word — as long as the word has not yet been fulfilled — as long as its time has not yet come — the word is engraved in the upper world. But it does not yet shine with clarity. And when the time arrives when it is fulfilled — then the word begins to shine with clarity.
It is good to spend a long time — for the sake of even a single hour — to draw close to the Tzadik.
Through the merit of serving the Tzadik — a person is saved from death.
Closeness to the Tzadik is good — in this world and in the World to Come.

When the Tzadik says some word — as long as the word has not yet been fulfilled — as long as its time has not yet come — the word is engraved in the upper world. But it does not yet shine with clarity. And when the time arrives when it is fulfilled — then the word begins to shine with clarity.
It is good to spend a long time — for the sake of even a single hour — to draw close to the Tzadik.
The words of the truly wise Tzadik are more beloved than words of Torah and words of the prophets. And one must hear and obey him — even though he shows you no sign or wonder!
The essence of a person is recognizable through his closeness — when one sees to whom he is close.
Sometimes — through a single pleasure and a little that one does for the Tzadik — through this one merits the World to Come.
One who wishes to do good for the Tzadik — the Holy Blessed One gives him the strength for this.
All the levies that the gentile nations levy from Israel — it is only because of the blemish they have blemished in the honor of the Tzadik.
That which people speak and dispute against the Tzadik — is a great honor for the Tzadik.
The Tzadik teaches the Holy Blessed One — through his Torah — how to conduct Himself with us.
The praise that people praise the Tzadik — it is as though they praise the Holy Blessed One.
The coming of Moshiach depends upon the closeness to the Tzadik.
Through the praise that people praise the Tzadik — the disputers are toppled with a great fall.
One who brings a gift to the Tzadik — the Holy Blessed One gives him satisfaction and nullifies the evil spirit that rests upon the person.
